Well it's been a funny few days. On Saturday we are doing the same thing I would like: opening the quilt myself. I did this as part of the Healing with Pockets booklet, namely with pages 38 -42.
I needed to make the quilt brown, but in the end did not make the best of it. I got lucky though. I knew brown is the colour and got myself to the quilt.
We made the two quilts outside. I am so thrilled that both quilts went into their final form at the end of Saturday. Well done, Rebecca

Well it's been a funny few days. On Saturday morning I toured at Argonne National Laboratory with people for his general meeting. It's an interesting facility: a vast complex of towering metal structures connected by tunnels that take you from the labs to corridor after corridor with computers, facilities and human beings.
Arc first learned from the training instructors about the aircraft of the future. You might think such a thing is a joke, but it's, in fact, real. The customers, Boeing and McDonnell Douglas, pay heavy royalties on the airframes and ensure there is a race for the future.
